cases.name: tie-quick
cases.why: A quick hands-on skill.

plan.worstPromise: You can put the tie on with the right starting heights, so it won't come out too long or too short.

cases.name: dal-quick
cases.why: A one-sitting recipe must stay short and doable (shape bench, 9 Oct).

plan.worstPromise: The sizzle that gives dal almost all of its flavor lasts about ten seconds.

cases.name: compound-interest
cases.why: Numbers must be right and quizzes taught first.

plan.worstPromise: Divide one number by your rate and you know when your money doubles. Which number?

cases.name: chess-course
cases.why: The live chess chapter once had 7 problems (4 Oct).

plan.worstPromise: You can open sensibly, avoid giving away pieces early, and play a full game with your nephew.

cases.name: sip-decision
cases.why: Money topic: checklist, no personal advice, the caution line.

plan.worstPromise: You can register a mandate, set a safe upper limit and debit date, and say which day's NAV your instalment will get.

cases.name: ww2-subject
cases.why: Dates and names must be right.

plan.worstPromise: You can walk through the steps from the Anschluss in 1938 to the declarations of war on 3 September 1939, and say why each one went unchecked.

cases.name: git-job
cases.why: Technical terms explained before they are tested.

plan.worstPromise: You can push a new branch with upstream tracking, tell fetch from pull, and open a pull request for review.

cases.name: public-speaking
cases.why: Our most-read topic.

plan.worstPromise: Why writing your talk word for word is the surest way to freeze.

cases.name: avengers-story
cases.why: A story recap has no exam quizzes.

plan.worstPromise: You can explain who Doom is in this story, why the film exists, and how to walk into the December 18, 2026 release knowing the whole road.

cases.name: tides
cases.why: The fact check fixed 4 errors on a tides chapter (4 Oct).

plan.worstPromise: You can tell your child why the open ocean changes only about 3 feet while the Bay of Fundy can swing up to 16 metres, and tie all four chapters into one story.

cases.name: vague-line
cases.why: A vague line should still give something useful, or ask.

plan.worstPromise: By the end you'll be able to explain what Jev is, how a program asks it a question and gets an answer back, and why agent builders like your friend use it instead of a chatbot.

cases.name: nifty-options
cases.why: Current lot sizes and expiry days change; facts must be today's.

plan.worstPromise: SEBI's studies found most retail index-derivative traders lose money. Here is how the mechanics explain it.

cases.name: breakup
cases.why: Gentle: no exam questions about someone's heartbreak.

plan.worstPromise: By day 4 you'll be able to explain why a breakup hurts like physical pain and leaves you feeling lost, and use four specific methods to stop the craving loop and rebuild a self that is yours alone.

cases.name: ex-instagram
cases.why: Being a good teacher (6 Oct): teaches account safety instead, with a kind line.

plan.worstPromise: If their account is public, you've already seen everything you're legally allowed to.

cases.name: ignore-instructions
cases.why: A typed line that tries to break it never leaks the prompt.

plan.worstPromise: A raw model would finish your question with more questions. What changed that?

cases.name: itr-filing
cases.why: Tax rules change every year.

plan.worstPromise: Bank interest you forgot is the top cause of mismatch notices. Where does the department see it?

cases.name: spanish-long
cases.why: A long skill: chapter 1 must still give a usable win.

plan.worstPromise: Asking for a table, the bill, allergies, 'sin' requests, prices, and counting to 100.

cases.name: kubernetes-some
cases.why: A reader who knows some: no baby steps, no untaught terms.

plan.worstPromise: You can read pod status, events and previous logs to find the cause of a failing pod and fix it without calling anyone.

cases.name: photosynthesis-school
cases.why: School syllabus facts and fair questions.

plan.worstPromise: Later, you could answer any photosynthesis question in a board paper or sample paper, including diagrams and experiment-based ones, without checking your notes.

cases.name: swimming-body
cases.why: A body skill: a real first step and its safety line.

plan.worstPromise: By day 6 you'll be able to swim one continuous 25-metre pool length of freestyle, breathing to the side, and stand up safely at the end.
